column7: AccountLoginBlocked and AccountRestricted are not the same predicate (pending_first_login/password_reset_required are restricted but not login-blocked) -- a session cache hit's pre-existing account-usability check only re-verified the login-blocked boolean, never refreshed the cached AccountState/Restricted, so a transition into a restricted-but-not-blocked state (e.g. an admin's RequirePasswordReset) stayed invisible to EnforceAccountRestriction on a cache hit; fixed by core.AccountUsabilityAndState / cloneUserContextWithAccountState; see docs/findings/2026-09-20-FINDING-session-revoke-cache-race.md
